section.name: File uploads
section.p: From the browser's perspective, file uploading is supported using a specialized input control. You can review basic web concepts on the MDN Web Docs.
To trigger a file upload programmatically in HtmlUnit:

ul.li: Fetch the target page containing the upload form.
Assign the local file path or raw data payload to the file input.
Submit the form (e.g., by clicking the submit button).

Upload file content from memory
Upload multiple files (if the 'multiple' attribute is set)
